column1: # Jev decision cards — hand-reviewable probe of the decision layer.
# Generated once by tools/score/DecisionCards.java; edit freely after that.
# Tab-separated. One card per line. Fill in the 'expected' column with the
# objective you think is correct; the tool then reports PASS/MISMATCH.
# EACH CARD IS EVALUATED TWICE, once per alliance (CO_PILOT cards excepted —
# it is the player-facing archetype, not a sparring bot). The Red pass mirrors
# the geometry through AllianceFlipUtil and flips the shift seed, so it is a true
# mirror: same phase, same relative hub roles. If the two passes choose
# different objectives the card is flagged ALLIANCE ASYMMETRY. Note that simply
# swapping the hub flags WITHOUT flipping the seed is NOT a mirror — the seed
# decides which alliance sits out, so that compares SHIFT1 against SHIFT2.
# Poses are BLUE-origin metres, zero chassis velocity. Hub = Blue hub at
# (4.6256, 4.0346). selfRot is not a column: the engine is given a fixed 180 deg
# facing so the shoot gate is always satisfiable.
# hubActive / oppHubActive / timeToShift are CROSS-CHECKS, not inputs. Hub
# state is derived from (matchTime, phase, seed) at evaluation time, because
# that is the only way both alliance passes can be mirrors. The tool flags any
# card whose authored values contradict the schedule as INVALID STATE.
#   matchTime     SECONDS REMAINING, not elapsed. 150 = match start, 0 = buzzer.
#   timeToShift   seconds until OUR hub changes state. 0 = both hubs active
#   oppZonePieces synthetic opponent poses in the opponent zone, so POACH and
#                 zone-scoring objectives are reachable at all (0 = none).
#   alliesHeldFuel feeds SCREEN_FOR_ALLY; >0 also places one ally at (3,2).
#   expected      YOUR ANSWER, judged against the BLUE pass. Blank = UNREVIEWED.
#   notes         why this card matters (shown in the report).
